_note: EAINT-9805 UI TS tab (Faizuddin, 2026-11-03). Marks: **bold**, ++bold green++, !!bold red!!. dev = result columns open for the TS; the rest are grey. 2026-11-03: iOS 18 / iOS 26 columns added for the thumbprint UI rows (UI_TS05, UI_TS22, UI_TS40).

sections.title: UCD MOBILE APP — SCREEN LAYOUT PER PAGE

rows.obj: Verify the Login page layout fits the screen.
rows.steps:
1. Open the app on the **Login** page with no saved account
2. Check the page again with saved accounts listed (build with biometric login)
3. On the fold phone, do it folded, then unfolded
rows.exp:
Ensure:
1. Login page -> Logo, fields and **[Log In]** shown in full, !!not cut or overlapped!!
2. Login page -> Saved account rows readable, long company names wrap

rows.obj: Verify the Home page and the bottom tab bar fit the screen.
rows.steps:
1. Login as **Main UCD**
2. Check the **Home** page
3. Tap each tab on the bottom tab bar (**Home**, **Help**, **Account**)
4. On the fold phone, do it folded, then unfolded
rows.exp:
Ensure:
1. Home page -> Menus and tiles shown in full
2. Bottom tab bar -> All tabs shown and tappable, !!not hidden under the navigation bar!!

rows.obj: Verify the Help and Account pages fit the screen.
rows.steps:
1. Open the **Help** tab
2. Open the **Account** tab
3. On the fold phone, do it folded, then unfolded
rows.exp:
Ensure:
1. Help page -> Text readable, !!not cut!!
2. Account page -> Rows and the **Login with Face ID** switch shown in full, long username wraps

rows.obj: Verify the STMS module page and the seller category list fit the screen.
rows.steps:
1. Open **STMS**
2. Tap **New STMS Transaction**
3. Check the **Sila Pilih Kategori ID PENJUAL** list
4. On the fold phone, do it folded, then unfolded
rows.exp:
Ensure:
1. STMS module page -> Buttons shown in full
2. Category list -> **MALAYSIAN**, **MyPR – PEMASTAUTIN TETAP** and **SYARIKAT** shown in full and tappable

rows.obj: Verify the Iris reader section at STMS Step 1 and STMS Step 3 fits the screen.
rows.steps:
1. Open **STMS Step 1** with the Iris reader connected
2. Read MyKad, place thumb
3. Repeat on **STMS Step 3**
4. On the fold phone, do it folded, then unfolded
rows.exp:
Ensure:
1. STMS Step 1 / STMS Step 3 -> MyKad details, thumbprint area, messages and buttons shown in full
2. STMS Step 1 / STMS Step 3 -> Long names and addresses wrap, !!not cut or overlapped!!

rows.obj: Verify the Dermalog section at STMS Step 1 fits the screen.
rows.steps:
1. Open **STMS Step 1** with Dermalog unplugged
2. Plug in **Dermalog**, read MyKad, place thumb
rows.exp:
Ensure:
1. STMS Step 1 -> "Fingerprint Verification" message on the page shown in full
2. STMS Step 1 -> MyKad details and thumbprint result shown in full, !!not cut or overlapped!!
rows.rem: Dermalog only: no iOS. Android 16 and 17 not included: "Dermalog does not officially support Android 16 and above." (Device & Test Scope R12).

rows.obj: Verify the STMS Step 2 form fits the screen while typing.
rows.steps:
1. Open **STMS Step 2**
2. Tap every field, open every dropdown and the date picker
3. Type in each field
4. On the fold phone, do it folded, then unfolded
rows.exp:
Ensure:
1. STMS Step 2 -> Labels and fields !!not cut!!
2. STMS Step 2 -> Dropdown list and date picker fit the screen
3. STMS Step 2 -> Field being typed !!not covered by the keyboard!!

rows.obj: Verify the STMS Step 4 JPJ check page fits the screen.
rows.steps:
1. Complete **STMS Step 1** to **STMS Step 3**
2. Check **STMS Step 4**
3. On the fold phone, do it folded, then unfolded
rows.exp:
Ensure:
1. STMS Step 4 -> JPJ result, vehicle details and buttons shown in full, !!not cut or overlapped!!

rows.obj: Verify the STMS Step 5 payment page and its pop-ups fit the screen.
rows.steps:
1. Open **STMS Step 5**
2. Open the **LKM Refund** pop-up and the insurance cancellation pop-up
3. On the fold phone, do it folded, then unfolded
rows.exp:
Ensure:
1. STMS Step 5 -> Amounts, add-ons and **[Pay]** shown in full
2. Pop-ups -> Text and buttons shown in full and tappable

rows.obj: Verify the STMS Step 6 page and the e-Signature pad fit the screen.
rows.steps:
1. Open **STMS Step 6**
2. Sign on the **e-Signature** pad
3. On the fold phone, do it folded, then unfolded
rows.exp:
Ensure:
1. STMS Step 6 -> Page shown in full
2. e-Signature pad -> Fits the screen, signature !!not cut!!

rows.obj: Verify the progress bar and Progress Details fit the screen on every step.
rows.steps:
1. On **STMS Step 1** to **STMS Step 6**, check the progress bar
2. Tap the progress bar to open **Progress Details**, tap **[X]**
3. On the fold phone, do it folded, then unfolded
rows.exp:
Ensure:
1. Progress bar -> Steps 1 to 6 and checkmarks shown in full
2. Progress Details -> Text readable, **[X]** closes it

rows.obj: Verify the STMS Transaction Listing fits the screen with many rows.
rows.steps:
1. Open **STMS Transaction Listing** with many transactions
2. Scroll to the end
3. Search and filter
4. On the fold phone, do it folded, then unfolded
rows.exp:
Ensure:
1. Listing -> Rows, status labels and dates shown in full, !!not cut or overlapped!!
2. Listing -> Search and filter controls shown in full and usable

rows.obj: Verify the STMS Transaction Details page and its documents fit the screen.
rows.steps:
1. Open a completed **STMS Transaction Details**
2. Open **Slip Pengesahan**, the Perakuan and the **LKM Refund** document
3. Zoom and scroll each document
4. On the fold phone, do it folded, then unfolded
rows.exp:
Ensure:
1. Transaction Details -> All fields readable, !!not cut!!
2. Documents -> Readable, thumbprint picture shown

rows.obj: Verify the STMS + Transfer History pages fit the screen.
rows.steps:
1. Open **STMS + Transfer History** for Individual and for Company
2. Open the listing and one details page
3. On the fold phone, do it folded, then unfolded
rows.exp:
Ensure:
1. STMS + Transfer History -> Listing and details shown in full, !!not cut or overlapped!!

rows.obj: Verify the UCD to UCD pages fit the screen.
rows.steps:
1. Open **UCD to UCD**
2. Open **Standard** and **Interstate**
3. On the fold phone, do it folded, then unfolded
rows.exp:
Ensure:
1. UCD to UCD -> Buttons and the Interstate notes shown in full, long text wraps

rows.obj: Verify the eSTM pages fit the screen.
rows.steps:
1. Create new **eSTM** transaction
2. Go through every eSTM step, including the consent fields
3. On the fold phone, do it folded, then unfolded
rows.exp:
Ensure:
1. eSTM -> Every step shown in full, !!not cut or overlapped!!
2. eSTM -> Field being typed !!not covered by the keyboard!!

rows.obj: Verify pop-ups, dialogs and toasts fit the screen.
rows.steps:
1. Trigger an error message, a confirm dialog, the **No internet connection** toast and the session expired message
2. On the fold phone, do it folded, then unfolded
rows.exp:
Ensure:
1. Pop-ups and dialogs -> Centred, text !!not cut!!, buttons tappable
2. Toasts -> Text shown in full, !!not hidden under the navigation bar!!

rows.obj: Verify long data wraps on the listing, details and form pages.
rows.steps:
1. Use a transaction with a long company name, long address and long vehicle model
2. Check **STMS Transaction Listing**, **STMS Transaction Details** and **STMS Step 2**
3. On the fold phone, do it folded, then unfolded
rows.exp:
Ensure:
1. Every page -> Long text wraps, !!not cut or overlapped!!

rows.obj: Verify the layout does not break with the largest font and display size.
rows.steps:
1. Set the phone font size and display size to the largest
2. Go through **Login**, **Home**, **STMS Step 1** and **STMS Transaction Listing**
3. On the fold phone, do it folded, then unfolded
rows.exp:
Ensure:
1. Every page -> Layout !!does not break!!, buttons tappable
2. Every page -> Text readable
rows.rem: Whether the app follows the phone font size: open with the developer.

sections.title: UCD MOBILE APP — SCREEN ROTATION (STAYS PORTRAIT)

rows.obj: Verify the screen stays in portrait when the device is rotated on non-transaction pages.
rows.steps:
1. Turn on device auto-rotate
2. Rotate the device on **Login**, **Home**, **STMS Transaction Listing** and **STMS Transaction Details**
3. On the fold phone, do it folded, then unfolded
rows.exp:
Ensure:
1. Every page -> Screen !!does not rotate!!, stays in portrait
2. Every page -> Layout !!does not break!!
rows.rem: Auto-rotate is disabled for now; rotation is a later phase (f2f notes 2026-10-29).

rows.obj: Verify the screen stays in portrait and typed data stays when rotated mid-process.
rows.steps:
1. Turn on device auto-rotate
2. Fill **STMS Step 2** fields
3. Rotate the device to landscape and back
4. On the fold phone, do it folded, then unfolded
rows.exp:
Ensure:
1. STMS Step 2 -> Screen !!does not rotate!!
2. STMS Step 2 -> Typed data kept

rows.obj: Verify rotating at the thumbprint step does not affect the read MyKad or the thumbprint.
rows.steps:
1. Turn on device auto-rotate
2. Read MyKad at **STMS Step 1** with Iris
3. Rotate the device, then place thumb
4. Repeat at **STMS Step 3**
5. On the fold phone, do it folded, then unfolded
rows.exp:
Ensure:
1. STMS Step 1 / STMS Step 3 -> Screen !!does not rotate!!
2. STMS Step 1 / STMS Step 3 -> MyKad details kept, ++"Verification Passed"++

rows.obj: Verify rotating with a pop-up or the e-Signature pad open keeps them open.
rows.steps:
1. Turn on device auto-rotate
2. Open the **LKM Refund** pop-up on **STMS Step 5**, rotate the device
3. Sign the **e-Signature** pad on **STMS Step 6**, rotate before **[Proceed]**
4. On the fold phone, do it folded, then unfolded
rows.exp:
Ensure:
1. STMS Step 5 / STMS Step 6 -> Screen !!does not rotate!!
2. Pop-up still open, signature kept

rows.obj: Verify the app opens in portrait when the device is held in landscape.
rows.steps:
1. Turn on device auto-rotate
2. Hold the device in landscape (tablet on a stand, phone sideways)
3. Open the app from closed, then from the background
4. On the fold phone, do it folded, then unfolded
rows.exp:
Ensure:
1. App -> Opens in portrait
2. App -> Layout !!does not break!!

rows.obj: Verify fast rotation during page loading does not crash the app.
rows.steps:
1. Turn on device auto-rotate
2. Tap **[Next]** on **STMS Step 2**
3. Rotate the device several times while the next page loads
4. On the fold phone, do it folded, then unfolded
rows.exp:
Ensure:
1. STMS Step 3 -> Opens in portrait
2. App -> !!does not crash or freeze!!

sections.title: UCD MOBILE APP — FOLD PHONE: FOLD AND UNFOLD MID PROCESS

rows.obj: Verify typed login details stay when the fold phone is unfolded or folded.
rows.steps:
1. On the cover screen, type username and password on **Login**
2. Unfold the phone, then fold it
3. Tap **[Log In]**
rows.exp:
Ensure:
1. Login page -> Typed values kept after each change
2. Home page -> Opens

rows.obj: Verify unfolding while MyKad is being read gives a clear result.
rows.steps:
1. Open **STMS Step 1** with Iris on the cover screen
2. Insert MyKad and start the read
3. Unfold the phone during the read
4. Repeat starting unfolded, then fold during the read
rows.exp:
Ensure:
1. STMS Step 1 -> MyKad read completes, or a clear read error with retry
2. App -> !!does not crash or freeze!!

rows.obj: Verify unfolding while a page is submitting does not submit twice.
rows.steps:
1. Tap **[Next]** on **STMS Step 2**, unfold the phone while it loads
2. Tap **[Pay]** on **STMS Step 5**, fold the phone while it loads
3. Check **STMS Transaction Listing**
rows.exp:
Ensure:
1. Next page -> Opens once
2. STMS Transaction Listing -> !!No duplicate transaction or payment!!

rows.obj: Verify the listing keeps its search and filter when the fold phone is unfolded or folded.
rows.steps:
1. Open **STMS Transaction Listing**, search and filter, scroll down
2. Unfold the phone, then fold it
rows.exp:
Ensure:
1. Listing -> Search and filter kept
2. Listing -> Layout fits each screen
rows.rem: Whether the scroll position is kept: open.

rows.obj: Verify eSTM data stays when the fold phone is unfolded or folded mid-process.
rows.steps:
1. Create new **eSTM** transaction on the cover screen, fill the consent fields
2. Unfold the phone, continue to the next step
3. Fold the phone, continue
rows.exp:
Ensure:
1. eSTM -> Typed data kept after each change
2. eSTM -> Layout fits each screen

rows.obj: Verify an open pop-up or dialog stays usable when the fold phone is unfolded or folded.
rows.steps:
1. Open the **LKM Refund** pop-up, an error message and the session expired message, one at a time
2. Unfold the phone, then fold it
3. Tap the pop-up buttons
rows.exp:
Ensure:
1. Pop-up -> Still shown after each change
2. Pop-up -> Buttons work

rows.obj: Verify the screen stays in portrait on both fold phone screens.
rows.steps:
1. Turn on device auto-rotate
2. Rotate the phone on the cover screen
3. Unfold, rotate the phone on the inner screen
rows.exp:
Ensure:
1. Cover and inner screen -> Screen !!does not rotate!!, stays in portrait

rows.obj: Verify the app keeps the page when the phone is folded with the cover-screen setting on and off.
rows.steps:
1. Turn on the phone setting that keeps apps open on the cover screen
2. Open **STMS Step 2**, fill fields on the inner screen, fold the phone
3. Turn the setting off, repeat
rows.exp:
Ensure:
1. Setting on -> App stays on **STMS Step 2**, typed data kept
2. Setting off -> App !!does not crash!!
rows.rem: Setting name on Galaxy Z Fold 7: check on the phone.

rows.obj: Verify the app in split screen on the inner screen.
rows.steps:
1. Unfold the phone
2. Open the app in split screen with another app
3. Go through **Home** and **STMS Step 1**
rows.exp:
Ensure:
1. App -> Layout usable, or split screen not allowed
2. App -> !!does not crash or freeze!!
rows.rem: Whether split screen is allowed: open with the developer. Note the result here.

sections.title: UCD MOBILE APP — TABLET AND IPAD (LARGE SCREEN)

rows.obj: Verify every main page fits the large screen.
rows.steps: 1. Go through **Login**, **Home**, **STMS Step 1** to **STMS Step 6**, **STMS Transaction Listing** and **STMS Transaction Details**
rows.exp:
Ensure:
1. Every page -> Text readable, icons and pictures !!not stretched!!
2. Every page -> Buttons shown in full and tappable

rows.obj: Verify the Iris reader section at STMS Step 1 and STMS Step 3 fits the large screen.
rows.steps:
1. Open **STMS Step 1** with the Iris reader connected
2. Read MyKad, place thumb
3. Repeat on **STMS Step 3**
rows.exp:
Ensure:
1. STMS Step 1 / STMS Step 3 -> Same messages and buttons as on the phone, shown in full
2. STMS Step 1 / STMS Step 3 -> ++"Verification Passed"++

rows.obj: Verify the keyboard does not cover the field being typed on the large screen.
rows.steps:
1. Tap the fields on **STMS Step 2** and the JPJ receipt email field on **STMS Step 3**
2. On iPad, repeat with the floating keyboard
rows.exp:
Ensure:
1. STMS Step 2 / STMS Step 3 -> Field being typed !!not covered by the keyboard!!

rows.obj: Verify the app in split screen on the tablet and in Split View on iPad.
rows.steps:
1. Open the app in split screen (tablet) or Split View / Slide Over (iPad) with another app
2. Go through **Home** and **STMS Step 1**
rows.exp:
Ensure:
1. App -> Layout usable, or split screen not allowed
2. App -> !!does not crash or freeze!!
rows.rem: Whether split screen is allowed: open with the developer. Note the result here.

rows.obj: Verify the listing shows all data on the large screen.
rows.steps:
1. Open **STMS Transaction Listing** with many transactions
2. Scroll to the end, search and filter
rows.exp:
Ensure:
1. Listing -> All rows and labels shown in full, !!no blank or cut area!!

sections.title: UCD MOBILE APP — IRIS THUMBPRINT UI PER iOS VERSION

rows.obj: Verify the Iris thumbprint screens look and work the same on every iOS version.
rows.steps:
1. On each iOS version, open **STMS Step 1** with the Iris reader connected
2. Read MyKad, place thumb, check the reader status, messages, buttons and any pop-up or dialog
3. Repeat on **STMS Step 3** and **eSTM Step 1**
4. Compare the screens across iOS 18, iOS 26, iOS 27 and iPadOS
rows.exp:
Ensure:
1. Every iOS version -> Same text, buttons and pop-ups, shown in full, !!not cut or overlapped!!
2. STMS Step 1 / STMS Step 3 / eSTM Step 1 -> ++"Verification Passed"++
rows.rem: iOS draws screens with its own design library, which changes per iOS version (Faizuddin, 2026-11-03).
